desc: Derive the binomial expansion formula for \((S_r-S_j)^K\) and identify the required maintained statistics.
Design the prefix scan invariant: maintain \(\sum_{j<r} S_j^t\) for every \(0\le t\le K\).
Confirm modular arithmetic details, including handling negative signs from \((-S_j)^t\).
Correct the initialization of prefix power moments and run all provided sample tests.
Verify edge cases such as \(N=1\), all-zero values, and maximum \(K=10\).
